name: Nameless Brass
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

Traits.name: Shielded Mind
Traits.text: The nameless brass's thoughts can't be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.
Traits.gmQuote: a brass automaton with no mouth no eyes and no name
Traits.expresses: a brass body with no mouth, no eyes, and no name

Traits.name: Fire Absorption
Traits.text: Whenever the nameless brass is subjected to Fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

Traits.name: Siege Monster
Traits.text: The nameless brass deals double damage to objects and structures.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The nameless brass makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Sundering Shove.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

Actions.name: Vault Breach (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 60 (11d10) Fire damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

Actions.name: Sundering Shove
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the nameless brass and has the Prone condition.

lore: Forged as an anonymous brass enforcer by a guild that wanted a guardian no bribe, threat, or plea could ever reach, it still walks the sealed halls of its makers' ruined vault, methodically breaking through every barrier built to keep it out.

generation.userConcept: a brass automaton with no mouth, no eyes and no name

clauses.text: a brass automaton with no mouth

generation.cite: composition after Clay Golem / Stone Golem (CR 9-10)

immunities: Fire, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a brass automaton with no mouth, no eyes and no name
